title: Create Outlook email drafts with AI for new conversations
h1: start a new outlook email as a draft
description: Turn a brief into a standalone Outlook draft with a subject, body and optional files. Review recipients yourself and use a different action for replies.
keywords: outlook draft new email with ai
answer: **get the new email written before choosing who gets it.** the bot can save an outlook draft with a subject, body and optional files. recipients can stay blank. it starts a new conversation rather than replying in an old thread. saving needs read and write access, but this action does not send the email.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: a new email, saved for you to finish.
what:
**get the introduction written while you decide who needs it.** give the bot the purpose and facts it can use. subject and body are required. to, cc, bcc and attachments are optional; addresses can stay empty.

answering an existing conversation? use create draft reply instead. that keeps the thread, but dusk counts that separate action as a send, so it follows your sending setting.
uses: prepare an introduction from your brief with the recipient left for you
save an event invitation with the venue brief attached
turn a project outline into an unsent announcement for an approved list

routine.message: each thursday at 09:50, read new outreach briefs added this week to the linked 'ready for introduction' drive folder for hazelspoke interiors. propose a fresh outlook email for each brief here. show its subject and body. wait for my agreement before saving a standalone draft with recipients blank. attach only the brochure named in that brief. skip briefs with an existing matching draft. never send or reply to old emails.
routine.needs: google drive read only; outlook read and write to create drafts and find existing ones
routine.output:
new draft proposal
subject: introducing hazelspoke interiors
body: a short introduction from vera’s studio brief
recipient: blank
ready for you to agree before it goes into drafts.

steps: connect outlook with **read and write** for draft creation
say this is a new conversation; give the brief and recipient choice
ask for the subject and body here before saving if you want a preview
open the saved draft, read the addresses and open its attachments; pause when outreach ends
watch: **this does not reply inside an old thread.** use the separate draft-reply action for that.
**formatting needs the right option.** tell the bot to enable html for html content, or use plain text.
**read only cannot save drafts.** restrict allowed actions to this one if no other outlook changes are needed.

faq.q: can i save a draft without a recipient?
faq.a: **yes, leave the recipient blank.** only subject and body are required. add addresses when you know who should receive it.

faq.q: does this send the email or reply in the old thread?
faq.a: **you get a fresh draft in outlook.** it starts a new conversation. sending it and drafting a reply in an old thread use separate actions.

steps: connect outlook and allow new drafts
give a two-line brief and a subject
ask for a draft with recipients blank
open the saved email and read it

mistakes.mistake: using a new draft to answer an old message
mistakes.fix: choose draft reply when keeping the conversation matters.

mistakes.mistake: treating weekly outreach as a repeated introduction
mistakes.fix: read new briefs from a folder and skip ones already drafted.

tip.text: a blank recipient field buys you room to edit before anyone can get the email.
